author: cellish
body:
Criteria
- Must have at least 1 day of play time. yes
- Must not be banned. Im not
- Must speak fluent english. yes
- Must be active on all Avicus services. yes

Application
Age: 13
Timezone: GMT +1
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
Actually not that much, I've tried to apply for staff, and It hasn't gone very well. I've applied for staff on some networks (one time here [Deinied]) and I've got denied on all of them just becuase of "Lack of Detail". I think that my biggest weakness in this application is going to be putting enough detail to get myself accepted, but Im gonna try my best. I've been Admin on a server that didn't even open as a public server. And I've also been a Moderator on alexanderjoe's build server which wasn't really big for me just because of that the server weren't a big server, there were no pvp so you couldn't find hackers, and It's not really a big job you have as a staff member on a build server with average 2 players. (SORRY ALEX XD)

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
My biggest weakness in moderating is probably swearing and maybe going inactive sometimes. Like Im a guy who've played Minecraft for AGES and I got into the Minecraft PvP session like a couple of years ago. Although I've been getting really good at pvp I can still rage and type bad things in chat. I can easily hackusate people, mostly on other servers than Avicus because I have plenty of punishments and infractions so I really don't wanna get a long punish because I can take it really hard because at many times I don't have ANYTHING to do at all other than being bored by playing on shitty pvp servers.

About my inactivity. Im usually not inactive on the server, but sometimes I just find the server EXTREMELY boring, mostly because of the lack of players, the lack of staff members, and the NON-LACK of hackers.
Hackers are something that annoys me alot, and probably many other players, so as a staff member I think that I could decrease the hacker count by ALOT. And later on get more and more active due to that I get to enjoy the server a bit more.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
I love helping people and the community out when they need help, for example banning hackers. Maybe they dpn't know how to do several things, they ask me, and I can answer just because of that I have been on the server for a long time and becuase of that I'm a moderator. The people mostly don't take their attention to normal players but mostly players who've been on the server for a long time (A well known member) and moderators and other staff members. 

Im not sure, but I've been watching some tuto's of how to make custom plugins so Idk if Im gonna get into making plugins or not but if I do I could possibly make new plugins for the server.

When I help people out I feel like I've done something good, I will be very motivated and I will do my best to make people happy and make this a good community. 
When I play Minecraft I play about 3-6 hours per day and If I could put some more  of that time on Avicus I think that I could make this a good community.

The staff team could be improved in some ways, either adding Prestige back which is going to make ALOT of people motivated to play on the server. They will stay on the server because they have a goal on Avicus, in the nowtime I think that everyone but keenan wants Prestige back and even if some people join the server they wont stay for long because they don't find the enjoyable side of it. 

I could maybe improve the staff team by motivating the staff members. In the current situation I think most of the staff members are from different timezones than I am, so that's probably why I never see any staff members but If more EU Staff were accepted that would help the server alot.
Me as a Moderator has probably been my biggest dream in my entire Minecraft life so far and if I was a moderator I think that I could get more people on at EU time. I think that I would make people enjoy the server by banning hackers. And by the time Im on I don't see many known people and never any staff members. So if they need help they can't get any because there is almost never any staff members or old members there to help them out. 

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
I think a leader needs to be nice and listen to its people. The leader should take the information that others give, for example if someone wants a new feature they should listen to it and take it up and maybe make a poll or something to see if more people wants the new feature or not. A leader to me needs to be nice loyal, the leader should have a well built community with gamemodes that people enjoy. For example if the only gamemode this server had was Frenzy, this server would've been dead months ago...
So, the leader should have an active staff team that works hard with new features. The leader should have a good Moderating Team that are going on the server often, checking for hackers or other things that are not allowed. 

I don't think Im a leader, but I think that I could possibly be a good one, I would take care of everyone in my community and I would work hard to get an as good staff team as possible, I would have anti-cheats made by someone who's good at hacking related stuff. But not an anti-cheat that creates blocklag and lagbacks etc because thats just annoying. 
So no, I wouldn't consider myself as a leader.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
I would say my most strong attribue would be my activity on the server but now when I think about it I think that most of the people who apply are quite active on the server. I think my strongest attribute would be that I've been playing on the server for a very long time so I know much about it. I think that some of the people who apply could be very new to the server, for example they log on and ask in chat like 10 minutes later "Can I be mod?", "How can I become a moderator?". That's probably their weakness. They don't know much about the community and maybe they could be new to Minecraft too. 


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
I think I should have to know the rules and punish people who has to be punished. I need to really be motivated and be a nice guy. 
I need to not be toxic to other players and take other players attention if they need help with anything.
Also, I will have to be active on all Avicus platforms and look through them as often as I can. 

I don't think I have all of the skills tbh but I could improve them. I think that Im good at being nice and helping people if they need help. I think Im active on the Avicus platforms, at least forums. I check forums daily and I'm defenetly going to be motivated as a staff member.
I don't think I have the skill to know all the rules because there are quite many rules but I kinda know whats allowed and whats not.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
As I said before, I play Minecraft alot even though I find it very boring sometimes. Anyways I think that I can commit alot of time as a staff member just because of that I will find the server more enjoyable. Also, I can maybe make a staff series on youtube :D

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
Due to that you can't ban or IP-check people as a Jr Mod there is no way you can know if someone's ban evading. But if he is and its clear that he is, I freeze him, contact a moderator or higher. If I can't contact a higher staff I make a report on youtube or on the forums.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
If Im a Jr Mod there's nothing I can do except just reporting them. If Im an Admin or something, I would probably warn him and give him a punishment if he doesn't listen to me.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
If they say they're not guilty, I would deny the application becuase of that he's lying. If he says he's guilty and is apologizing I would accept the application if it's not immediately after he got punished.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I would report him for showing private staff information, or just let him be because it doesn't matter if nobody else can see it.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
I don't think I can do anything about it if Im a Jr Moderator. Otherwise if Im a higher rank like a Dev I can possibly do something. It also depends on what decision they made. for example if they all decides to retire there's nothing I can do but telling them not to even if its not going to work. If it's for example a feature that I don't like, I don't think I can do anything unless there's a poll and more people dont want it than people want it.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you
If I get moderator on Avicus I would be very happy. I would first, log on Avicus and see if it's true and then I would probably tell my friends. 


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
Honestly, I don't really know, probably something inbetween.
Avicus actually means alot to me, it was one of the first Minecraft communities I started to play on and actually stay on. Avicus has done so much to me while talking about pvp. At the beggining when I joined the server I thought like everyone was hacking. Someone said they were buildhacking so i reported like everyone who could ninja and breezily for buildhacks. 


Do you speak any other languages than English?
Swedish
Spanish (Learning)

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
Umm, My name is Sam or, my real name is Samuel but call me Sam please. Im 13 years old and I like playing minecraft, reading, drawing and designing stuff. 
Also, accept me :)

replies.body: [Reviewing] - Your application has been tagged reviewing and will remain like this until at least 3 other Senior Staff members read over your application and vote.

replies.author: JDKL
replies.body:
[Denied] - I am sorry to say your application has been denied.

Here are the reasons why:

- Overall Behavior on the network needs to improve. We suggest that if you are interested in becoming Mod, you need to improve your behavior and attitude on all Avicus platforms.

You may not submit another application.
